stances.FUJ: Wind God's Kamae stance. Hold down after moves like f+3 or f+4 to enter it.
stances.RAI: Thunder God's Kamae stance. Hold forward after sidestep 2 (and some other moves) to enter it.

moves.label: Electric (EWGF)
moves.tip: Launcher. Press 2 at the exact moment you hit down-forward.

moves.label: Wind God Fist
moves.tip: Same launcher without the exact timing. Easier.

moves.label: Hell Sweep x2
moves.tip: Hell Sweep with the second kick.

moves.label: Mid poke
moves.tip: Quick mid. Used to carry in combos.

moves.label: Mid kick into FUJ
moves.tip: Hold down after the kick to enter FUJ stance.

moves.label: f+4
moves.tip: Safe mid. Can go into FUJ stance.

moves.label: Counter-hit launcher
moves.tip: Launches when it interrupts their attack.

moves.label: Jumping launcher
moves.tip: Also used to carry in combos.

moves.label: Sidestep 2 into RAI
moves.tip: Hold forward after the punch to enter RAI stance.

moves.label: RAI wall splat
moves.tip: Mid from RAI stance. Wall splats.

moves.label: Dash
moves.tip: Tap forward twice to close the gap.

combos.name: First Combo
combos.author: Trunkiez (TekkenDocs guide)
combos.notes: No electrics and no stances. Land any one of the starters, then do the route.

combos.name: Hell Sweep Pickup
combos.author: Trunkiez (TekkenDocs guide)
combos.notes: Easy damage after the full Hell Sweep string.

combos.name: Wind God Fist Route
combos.author: Trunkiez (TekkenDocs guide)
combos.route: f,n,d,df+2 > f+3 > df+1 > f+3,D > RAI 2 > SS 2,F > RAI 1
combos.notes: First step toward the staple. Uses the easier Wind God Fist instead of the Electric. Written exactly as it appears in the source guide.

combos.name: Electric Staple
combos.author: Trunkiez (TekkenDocs guide)
combos.route: f,n,d,df:2 > f,n,d,df:2 > f+3 > df+1 > f+3,D > FUJ 2 > SS 2,F > RAI 1
combos.notes: Main combo after an Electric or f,f+2. Two Electrics in a row is the hard part.

combos.name: Counter-Hit Launcher Route
combos.author: Trunkiez (TekkenDocs guide)
combos.notes: Ends with qcf+2 for wall break.

combos.name: Hell Sweep Staple
combos.author: Trunkiez (TekkenDocs guide)
combos.route: f,n,d,df:2 > f+3,D > df+4,4,1 > f+3,D > FUJ 2 > SS 2,F > RAI 1
combos.notes: Full combo from a counter-hit Hell Sweep or the two-kick Hell Sweep.

combos.name: Wall Ender
combos.author: Trunkiez (TekkenDocs guide)
combos.notes: Use when the opponent is splatted on the wall.

combos.name: Wall Combo with Tornado
combos.author: Trunkiez (TekkenDocs guide)
combos.notes: Use at the wall when you have not used your tornado yet in the combo.

combos.name: Headbutt Follow-up
combos.author: Trunkiez (TekkenDocs guide)
combos.notes: Guaranteed follow-up after a counter-hit while-standing 2 or the headbutt.

combos.name: While-Standing 1 Pickup
combos.author: Trunkiez (TekkenDocs guide)
combos.notes: Needs the exact-timing version of the punch.
